skills.name: Turn the Tide
lines: Fire type slash attack on a single enemy (XL, increase skill damage 10 times 10x of the standard skill multiplier of 200% )
* Restore all Main and Reserve party members' HP to 100% + Revive all fallen party members
* The fewer frontline allies, the more strength increases (Max 9x)
** When using max strength: Physical Resistance and Magic Resistance of user +100% (current turn only)
* This skill can only be used once per battle
* Replaces the basic attack
